description: List the idempotent overage-minutes ledger from billing_overage_charges (legacy per-minute-overage tiers only — 2026 plans carry no overage). GET /v1/balance/get_balance only returns an aggregate; this returns the underlying per-period ledger rows. Mirrors GET /api/v1/overage-charges.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).
